name: fest
description: Self-hosted Claude Code gateway: per-user subscription pass-through, central token/cost monitoring, model routing.

scripts.demo: FEST_DB=./data/demo.db FEST_USAGE_LOG=./data/demo.jsonl node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/bin/fest.ts seed --reset && FEST_DB=./data/demo.db FEST_USAGE_LOG=./data/demo.jsonl node tools/dev.mjs
scripts.demo:clean: FEST_DB=./data/demo.db FEST_USAGE_LOG=./data/demo.jsonl node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/bin/fest.ts seed --clear && rm -f ./data/demo.jsonl
